get.description: Discover whether the current user can analyze this table, readable fields, chart defaults, limits and backend capabilities.

post.description: Profile one column of a table under a filter: counts, nulls, distinct values, top values, numeric statistics and histogram, date patterns; every number has a drill-through filter unless privacy suppresses it.
Page through distinct stored values with display labels, counts and drill-through filters; search narrows stored values.

Compare filtered A with filtered B (null means the whole permitted table). Return means, medians or category shares, B-minus-A deltas, valid significance tests and count-equivalent drills. Only FULL fields are accepted.

Compare category shares or numeric quartiles across session-timezone calendar buckets. Compute descriptive PSI between the first and last complete nonempty buckets using fixed categories or baseline quartile bins.

Compute a Pearson correlation matrix for 2 to 12 distinct FULL numeric fields, using paired non-null records. Every cell includes n and parameters for the scatter endpoint; core pushes down CORR or uses bounded streaming.

Return at most 2000 paired numeric points as the user, ordered by primary key when core query sampling is unavailable, plus a least-squares line fitted to the sample. Privacy disables individual drills and suppresses small populations.

Count combinations of two FULL fields with row and column shares, up to 20 categories per axis plus Other. Test independence using chi-square and Cramer V after pooling low expected counts; privacy suppresses small cells and their drills.

Group records by up to 3 row and 2 column fields (with date or numeric buckets) and compute counts, sums, averages, min/max, distinct counts or percentiles per cell; every cell has a drill-through filter.
Profile readable fields under a filter for completeness, uniqueness, constant or empty columns and candidate keys.
Group matching records by the selected readable fields and return repeated tuples with counts and drill-through filters.
Start an owner-scoped exact column or table profile. Poll the returned runId until COMPLETE or FAILED; results honor the current session permissions.

get.description: Read status, timestamps and the typed columnProfile or tableProfile result of an owner-scoped run. Completed results are rechecked against current permissions.
